title: Live Debugging in Smalltalk
summary: A brief demo of the Smalltalk debugger, including defining a method that doesn't exist yet while the program is stopped mid-crash.
why: HN cites it as a concise demo of live debugging and editing code in a running Smalltalk environment.

quote.text: That's a demo of a Smalltalk environment with the programmer deliberately writing some code that crashes, going into the debugger, adding the method on the fly
